description: This file implements a simulation framework for a Multi-AP network, including classes for managing simulation events, algorithms, message forwarding, and timing, with references to device-related modules.

classes.name: Tick
classes.description: Represents a unit of simulation time measured in 100 microsecond ticks.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents a scheduled event in the simulation, with a trigger time, callback, and description.

classes.name: Algorithm
classes.description: Base class for algorithms that run on devices within the simulation, providing methods for starting, handling messages, and scheduling events.

classes.name: Simulation
classes.description: Manages the execution of simulation events, algorithms, and message passing within a network.

methods.name: Tick.s
methods.description: Creates a Tick object representing a specified number of seconds.

methods.name: Event.__init__
methods.description: Initializes an Event with a trigger time, callback, and description.

methods.name: Algorithm.start
methods.description: Placeholder for initializing an algorithm on device startup.

methods.name: Algorithm.handle_message
methods.description: Placeholder for processing incoming messages on a device.

methods.name: Algorithm.set_start
methods.description: Schedules a startup event for the algorithm on a device.

methods.name: Algorithm.set_timeout
methods.description: Schedules a future callback for the algorithm.

methods.name: Simulation.add_event
methods.description: Schedules an event at a specific simulation tick.

methods.name: Simulation.add_algorithm_to_device
methods.description: Associates an algorithm with a device and schedules its startup.

methods.name: Simulation.run
methods.description: Executes the simulation, processing events in order and invoking a checker function.

methods.name: forward_msg
methods.description: Handles message forwarding logic based on bridge and link states.

methods.name: send_msg
methods.description: Initiates message sending with flooding and bridge logic.
